```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

NHPD_df <- read_excel("data/NHPD Properties Only Export.xlsx")

# significant number of these units don't have construction start or end dates :( 
# HUD sec. 504 passed in 1973
#Note: target tenant type has some "elderly or disabled, disabled" -- does this mean all units (or more than 5% of units would be accessible??)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

date_earliest_const_start <- as.Date(NHPD_df$`Earliest Construction Date`)

NHPD_since_1973 <- NHPD_df %>%
  #make target columns part of Date class
  mutate(
    `Earliest Construction Date` = as.Date(`Earliest Construction Date`),
    `Latest Construction Date` = as.Date(`Latest Construction Date`)
  ) %>%
  # keep only listings from after 1973
  # if earliest year == latest year AND year > 1973,  else if latest const. year > 1973
  filter((
    year(`Earliest Construction Date`) == year(`Latest Construction Date`) &
      year(`Earliest Construction Date`) > 1973
  ) |
    year(`Latest Construction Date`) > 1973) %>%
  # developments with more than 5 units
  filter(`Total Units` > 5)


total_units <- sum(NHPD_since_1973$`Total Units`)
units_accessible <- total_units * .05
units_accessible



```
